topics.hook_summary: Three days ago this dude says the Kaspa bears are back in charge, one cent is in play. And we blew him out of the water, man. Same crowd that sold Kaspa at the bottom to buy Solana at the top, the most dumbest thing ever.

Golden Kitty is at 5.3 million and this thing is rocking. I was saying a few days ago it is going to be 8 million; realistically it could be at 8 million this coming week. Good play because so many people are getting behind it.

The first vProg is live: tic-tac-toe on Kaspa testnet with real execution. Verifiable programs on the L1, anybody can build on it, really really bullish for Kaspa. Make anything you want and it is on a proof of work coin.

We just got a nice runner, the 114x, Perps Pad on Solana: 90K on the 5th, nearly 11 million on the 13th. That is eight days. Multiple scores of plays in our community, and one thing after another is going to pump. So goddamn fun.

second bear, same fate: selling Kaspa at the bottom to buy Solana at the top was the most dumbest thing ever, and his discord followed him

milestone beat: Kaspa flipped Polygon in market cap, well deserved
forward payoff closer: over the next few years? Yeah, definitely, 50 cents, I think that's going to happen

peak_beats.note: 'Oh man. Just like three days ago, and we blew him out of the water, man.' The hardest line in the stream.
'selling Kaspa at the bottom so you can buy Solana at the top. It was the most dumbest thing ever.'
